findings.evidenceScope: Selected Flora of China species diagnosis through web retrieval; adult leaf, shoot and reproductive descriptions inform selected morphology, not numerical dynamics. Direct local HTML failed; no local full-text reading claimed.
corrections: Selected a spreading forked habit consistent with the retained photograph, rather than treating a columnar cultivated form as universal.

Changed leaf insertion to opposite decussate pairs/four ranks, oriented appressed scale surfaces against the twigs and added overlapping three-dimensional terminal branchlets to reduce the initially bare crown.
Replaced open fan-like cone scales with a closed globoid surface containing twelve selected shield regions and small central relief cues.
findings.residual: Crown outline, branching and bark remain simplified and too regular; leaf scales are coarse at close range and woody shield relief is shallow. Exact scale counts vary in nature; this selected number is not a measured individual. Some foliage overlaps cone landmarks. Natural optics, cultivar/age variation and cone opening are incomplete.
